scenes.text: Claude built a performance review tool with one hard rule: who sees what. The employee sees the manager's review and final rating only after release. Peer feedback comes without names, and only if two peers answered. Calibration notes, never.
Then the gaps. Sixty-four of them. Nothing stopped an admin from calibrating her own review. And the employee would have seen the rating from before calibration. Both are fixed now.
Lattice Performance is ten dollars a seat a month, with a four thousand dollar yearly minimum. Under thirty-three people, you pay the minimum. All seventeen checks passed, and the spec is free.
